selection_basis: After discovery and independent source review; before any native prediction. Evidence-selected development diagnostic, not held-out sampling.

questions.text: Among marketing value, number of payments, and number of physicians receiving payments, which has the largest source-reported point estimate for opioid prescribing rates per 1-SD exposure increase? Report its exposure label and displayed value; do not infer significance of differences.

Comparing the source-reported standardized point estimates, does the article sentence naming the greatest prescribing-rate effect agree with the corrected prescribing numbers? Answer agree, disagree, or uncertain.

For the separate prescription-opioid overdose-death outcome, which of the same three exposures has the largest source-reported point estimate per 1-SD increase? Report its exposure label and displayed value.

response_contract.top_level: Object with exactly answers: a list of exactly three objects in Q1,Q2,Q3 order.
response_contract.value: finite numeric displayed point estimate, or null when uncertain
response_contract.evidence_ids: Nonempty unique list drawn from P1,P2,P3,P4. No quotations or explanations.

limitations: One current-document case; not historical correction replay.
Publisher notice and author assertions are not silently equated for authority.
Source labels aRR despite Tobit-method wording; only source-reported values and prose consistency are queried.
No causal or statistical significance comparison is requested.
